leads.title: Upstate deputy resigns amid investigation into Flock misuse
leads.summary: Anderson County Deputy Caleb Dixon resigned on Monday following an internal investigation into the potential misuse of Flock cameras. This marks the second such resignation in the county this month, following former deputy Eric Center. Recent months have seen several law enforcement agencies in South Carolina fire or accept resignations from officers for similar unauthorized uses of license plate reader technology.
